name: Wright-Patterson AFB
description: Home of Air Force Materiel Command HQ, Wright-Patterson is the Air Force's premier acquisition, research, and logistics center. Nearly 30,000 military and civilian personnel.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant ID or passport is required for base access. Non-compliant IDs require additional vetting — allow extra time at gates.

gates.name: Area A Gate 1A (Springfield St / Ohio SR-4)

gates.name: Area B Gate (Skeel Ave / Kettering Blvd)

gates.notes: New visitors and guests without base access credentials must stop here.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates, and all travel receipts for finance.

sections.title: In-Processing
sections.body: Check in with your gaining unit and complete MPF in-processing within 5 duty days. The base has both Area A and Area B — confirm which area your unit is in before arrival.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Housing at 937-257-6881 before arrival. Privatized family housing (Liberty Military Housing). Lodging: Falcon Inn 937-257-3311. Dorm management: 937-257-5218.

sections.title: National Museum of the USAF
sections.body: World's largest military aviation museum is on base — free admission daily 0900-1700. Great orientation resource for families new to Air Force history.
